reasoning_content:
The builder stage mounts only uv.lock and pyproject.toml. The path deps need to be present. The issue: uv sync needs the local path deps to resolve metadata. The `--no-install-project` skips the project itself but path deps are dependencies so still needed.

I need to modify the Dockerfile so that shared services are copied before the first uv sync. Let me create a patched Dockerfile that copies the shared services into place. This is a build-context workaround. Let me patch it.

Actually, a cleaner approach: build with the full monorepo root as context, where `03-shared-services/` is at the right relative path from `/app`. But the Dockerfile copies `. /app`, so if context is monorepo root, `.` = monorepo root, and then 02-backend/dokumentenpruefung wouldn't be at /app. The pyproject path deps are `../../03-shared-services/bizlog` relative to the project dir.

Hmm, the guide says: "Use the monorepo root as the build context and point -f to the service Dockerfile". But the Dockerfile does `COPY . /app` and NOWORKDIR is the service dir. With build context = root, `COPY . /app` copies entire monorepo root to /app, then uv sync looks for pyproject.toml at /app/pyproject.toml which doesn't exist. So that doesn't work either directly.

Let me instead patch the temp Dockerfile: set WORKDIR to /app/02-backend/<service> and copy the tree preserving layout. Actually simpler: In the temp context /tmp/dpctx, I have dokumenenpruefung files at root and 03-shared-services as subdir. I patch pyproject to point to `03-shared-services/...`. Then patch Dockerfile to COPY the shared services before first uv sync.

But the first uv sync runs with only bind mounts for uv.lock and pyproject.toml (not COPY). So the shared dir won't be present. I need to add COPY of 03-shared-services before that sync. Let me patch.

action.command:
cd /tmp/dpctx && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='Dockerfile'
s=open(p).read()
# In builder stage, before the first uv sync, copy shared services into /app/03-shared-services
marker='WORKDIR /app\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \\\n  uv sync --locked --no-install-project --no-dev'
assert marker in s, "marker not found"
repl='WORKDIR /app\nCOPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \\\n  --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \\\n  --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \\\n  uv sync --locked --no-install-project --no-dev'
s=s.replace(marker,repl,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("patched")
EOF
sed -n '44,58p' Dockerfile
